name: zalo-apple-glass-ui
description: Desktop UI demo with an optional, unsupported personal zca-js client for a secondary Zalo account.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run check && npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win portable --x64 && node tools/hash-release.cjs && node tools/mark-delivery.cjs && node tools/verify-asar.cjs
scripts.lint: eslint src/renderer src/shared src/adapters src/services src/transport src/composition src/design-system src/components electron tests/core.test.ts tests/design-system.test.ts tests/adapters.test.ts tests/services.test.ts tests/transport.test.ts tests/composition.test.ts tests/ipc-contract.test.ts tests/protocol-boundary.test.ts tests/protocol-mapper.test.ts tests/live.test.ts tests/e2e vite.config.mts playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none tests/logic.test.cjs tests/core.test.ts tests/design-system.test.ts tests/adapters.test.ts tests/services.test.ts tests/transport.test.ts tests/composition.test.ts tests/ipc-contract.test.ts tests/protocol-boundary.test.ts tests/protocol-mapper.test.ts tests/live.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
